definitions.explanation: An artificial replacement for a missing hand or arm. Ranges from simple cosmetic devices to sophisticated electronic prosthetics.

examples.japanese: {義手|ぎしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けている→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: He is wearing a prosthetic hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{義手|ぎしゅ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{指|ゆび}→指：01518_yubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動|うご}かす→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The latest prosthetic hands can move their fingers freely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{片腕|かたうで}→片腕：13509_kataude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{義手|ぎしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{日常生活|にちじょうせいかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: He lost an arm in an accident, but he uses a prosthetic arm for daily life.

notes:
USAGE:
{義手|ぎしゅ} literally means "righteous hand" — the character {義|ぎ} here means "substitute" or "artificial" (as in ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧ meaning social obligation). This {義|ぎ} prefix is used for various prosthetics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {義手|ぎしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to put on a prosthetic hand)
- {義手|ぎしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{装着|そうちゃく}する→装着する：22176_souchakusuru⟧ (to wear/fit a prosthetic — formal)
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧{義手|ぎしゅ} (electric/powered prosthetic hand)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{義足|ぎそく}→義足：13916_gisoku⟧: prosthetic leg
- {義歯|ぎし}: false teeth, dentures
- {義眼|ぎがん}: artificial eye
